label: PF Backlog 611
title: Develop red: test pollution committed into data/learnings.json breaks test_global_render_unchanged (scratch loop-learning marker 0270)
body: origin/develop:product-forge/data/learnings.json contains test-pollution rules (e.g. "rule": "scratch loop-learning marker 0270"), committed in 068dc588. As a result test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_scoped_learnings.py::test_global_render_unchanged FAILS (asserts a global rule is rendered; the LEARNINGS render instead shows scratch markers). This fails in isolation and in CI precheck --full (58 gates), so it blocks EVERY PR merge to develop (observed: PR #93 BI-PF-1293 docs-only, mergeable but structure gate red). Root cause: a test wrote scratch learnings into the real store (weak isolation) and they were committed. Fix: purge scratch/test entries from data/learnings.json + add a guard so tests use an isolated learnings store (temp scope) and cannot pollute the committed store.

brief.problem: Committed test pollution in data/learnings.json fails a pipeline test on develop, blocking all PR merges.
brief.what_adds: Purge scratch learnings + guard test isolation for the learnings store.
brief.why: develop is red; no PR can merge (including docs-only ones).

objective: Restore develop green: purge test pollution from data/learnings.json + prevent test writes to the real learnings store.
acceptance_criteria: data/learnings.json contains no scratch/test marker entries; test_global_render_unchanged passes in isolation and in precheck --full.
A test-isolation guard ensures learnings writes in tests target a temp scope/store, never the committed store.
CI precheck --full green on develop; existing PRs (e.g. #93) can merge.
